id: title:Gilbert09:tell customers to sync less often when the rate limit runs out

review.posthog_relevance: Provides customer-facing guidance messages for Anthropic API rate limit exhaustion, distinguishing it from other errors.
review.reason: Adds a dictionary mapping HTTP 429 patterns to customer-facing guidance messages and a test asserting these messages contain 'sync less often'. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and documentation change.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retry-after handling or the actual scheduling changes, only the error message and a test. The tier cannot be established.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retry-after handling or the actual scheduling changes, only the error message and a test. The tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retry_exhausted_errors returning a dictionary mapping HTTP 429 patterns to customer-facing guidance messages, and adds a test asserting that these messages contain 'sync less often'.
